concreteStateBag.setterBehavior: A non-null state object supplies its lookup key from object offset +0x10. A null state object erases the key passed separately. The bag updates a synchronized keyed container rooted at bag offset +0x10.

conclusion: Version 1.3 resolves MovieClipLoader state key 22 through an owner-side forwarding interface before dispatching to a backing provider. The known concrete bag implements set and get at 0x821EE910 and 0x821EEA38, including parent fallback on lookup miss. Both fulfilled-request constructors repeat the key-22 lookup and attach their route-specific object through the returned state, but no bounded direct static edge reaches the title stream loader.
